subject: Renewal: moving to Azure Marketplace billing — kickoff and next steps
messages:
From: Patricia Gomez <p.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-25T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Billing for upcoming renewal - moving to Azure Marketplace?

Hi Karthik,

We're approaching our renewal window with Redwood in late January and Procurement has asked whether we can convert to Azure Marketplace billing instead of the current direct invoicing. The ask is primarily driven by our finance team's desire to consolidate cloud spend and make procurement flow through our existing marketplace approvals.

Can you outline the steps, timeline, and what information you would need from us? Specifically:
- How entitlements / seat counts map to marketplace SKUs
- What the invoice will look like (tax, legal entity)
- Any changes to data residency or SLA commitments

I've attached our procurement requirements doc for context. Would appreciate a quick summary and an estimated kickoff date if conversion is possible.

Thanks,
Patricia Gomez
Sr. Procurement Manager
Horizon Health
Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Patricia Gomez <p.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-26T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Billing for upcoming renewal - moving to Azure Marketplace?

Hi Patricia — thanks for the note and the procurement packet. Short answer: yes, we can move your renewal to the Azure Marketplace, and we've done this for several enterprise customers with similar constraints. High level timeline and asks below: 

1) Timeline (target):
   - Week 0 (this week): confirm mutual action plan and legal amendment scope
   - Week 1-2: Seller registration & publish request to Azure Publisher Portal (vendor side)
   - Week 2-3: Entitlement mapping & test invoicing with your finance team
   - Week 4: Final sign-off and transition on renewal date

2) Key items we need from Horizon:
   - Legal entity and tax ID for invoice lines
   - Exact seat counts / committed SKUs at renewal (to map to marketplace SKUs)
   - Procurement contact for test invoices (Mike Tan?)

3) What changes for you:
   - Invoicing will come via Microsoft (Azure Marketplace) and will include Microsoft tax handling; Redwood will provide SKU-level usage/export to reconcile
   - No change to runtime SLA or data residency — those remain per your existing contract; we will include the same SLOs in the amendment

I attached a one-page conversion checklist that outlines the technical/ops steps. Can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week (Tue/Wed) to run through roles and timeline?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: marketplace_conversion_checklist.xlsx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Billing for upcoming renewal - moving to Azure Marketplace?

Karthik / team — looping in a couple of ops notes from Sales Ops / Commercial: 

- Marketplace amendments: Legal will need a short addendum (term + invoicing flow). I can draft a template; for Horizon we can propose a marketplace-billing credit of 5% on committed spend for the first 12 months to offset marketplace margin (subject to finance approval).
- Procurement: we'll ask for the PO-to-invoice mapping Horizon expects. That helps us pre-authorize the SKU mapping in the Azure listing.
- Timing: if we aim for Azure billing to be active on the renewal date (2027-01-28), we should start publish/process this week to allow for any Azure validation delays.

I'll prepare a draft amendment and attach it for internal review. Karthik — if you can confirm the meeting time I'll invite Legal and our Marketplace Program Manager to the kickoff.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: draft_amendment_terms.docx

From: Patricia Gomez <p.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@horizonhealth.com, Mike Tan <m.tan@horizonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Billing for upcoming renewal - moving to Azure Marketplace?

Karthik / Laura,

Thanks — that timeline looks reasonable. A couple quick clarifications from Procurement: 
- Invoice format: we need the invoice to show Horizon Health, Inc. (EIN: 22-334455) and include a PO number field. Will marketplace invoices support an explicit PO number on the line item?
- Tax: will tax handling be visible on the invoice detail or handled entirely by Microsoft? We need to reconcile tax for our internal reporting.
- Am I correct that entitlements will still be managed by Redwood (we won't lose access controls)?

We can make Mike the procurement lead for the kickoff. Tue 12/1 at 10am PT or Wed 12/2 at 9am PT works for us.

On the entitlements question — Patricia wrote: 
> "We need the seat mapping to be one-to-one so our internal SSO and provisioning scripts remain the same."

Looking forward to the draft amendment and the checklist you mentioned.

Best,
Patricia
Sr. Procurement Manager
Horizon Health

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Patricia Gomez <p.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-07T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Billing for upcoming renewal - moving to Azure Marketplace? — Kickoff confirmed

Patricia / Mike — thanks for confirming. We're locked for Tue 2026-12-01 10:00 PT (invitation sent separately). Quick responses to your procurement Qs and the mutual action plan attached below.

Answers: 
- PO field: Azure Marketplace supports customer PO numbers on the invoice metadata; in practice the PO appears on the Microsoft invoice. We'll coordinate a test invoice during the entitlements mapping stage so your AP team can confirm the format.
- Tax: Microsoft will collect and show tax on the invoice where applicable. We'll provide a tax reconciliation CSV for your records.
- Entitlements / access: entitlement enforcement (SSO mapping / role assignments) continues to be controlled by Redwood via our entitlement service — marketplace billing does not change how identities or access are provisioned. We will map your existing seat SKUs to marketplace SKUs 1:1.

Mutual action plan (short):
- Today: Kickoff meeting (Dec 1) — attendees: Karhtik (Sales), Laura (Commercial Ops), Dylan (Customer Success), Patricia + Mike (Horizon Procurement), Horizon IT lead
- Day 1-7: Legal amendment + Docusign routing (we will send the draft amendment)
- Day 7-21: Azure publisher submission, SKU entitlement mapping, test invoice run with Horizon AP
- Renewal date (2027-01-28): Marketplace billing active for new term

Attachments (as promised): marketplace_conversion_checklist.xlsx, draft_amendment_terms.docx. I'll also create the HubSpot record and link it in the invite so we can track tasks.

If anything comes up before the kickoff ping me directly.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0186
